title: ChatModelRequest
description: A complete request to a Large Language Model (LLM) combining prompt engineering components with generation parameters

role.description: Role definition (e.g., "You are a helpful assistant")

rawQuery.description: The raw query or input text (Query type, assumed to be object)

rules.description: List of behavioral rules the LLM must follow

constraints.description: Additional constraints (e.g., length limits, forbidden content)

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0.0 - 2.0). Higher = more random, lower = more deterministic.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling threshold (0.0 - 1.0). Only tokens with cumulative probability >= topP are considered.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. null = model's maximum allowed.

presencePenalty.description: Presence penalty (-2.0 - 2.0). Positive values discourage repeating tokens already present.

frequencyPenalty.description: Frequency penalty (-2.0 - 2.0). Positive values discourage frequent token repetition.

n.description: Number of completion choices to generate per prompt.

stream.description: Whether to stream partial results as they are generated.

logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the generated tokens.

echo.description: Whether to echo the prompt in the response.

seed.description: Deterministic seed for reproducible results (not supported by all providers).

bestOf.description: Number of completions generated server-side to choose the best one. Requires provider support.

logitBias.description: Token bias adjustments: map token IDs to bias values (-100 to 100). Positive makes token more likely, negative less likely.

description: Validation rules align with ChatModelRequest.validate() method in Java class
